plainTranslation: The Neptune person may cloud the Sun person's sense of what is real in the bond. Inspiration is possible, but mixed signals, idealization, or avoidance can drain confidence. Ask direct questions and trust patterns more than promises.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
